priorityList: Keep Shadowform active at all times.
Maintain Vampiric Touch on your target to ensure all primary damage-over-time effects are active.
Use Power Infusion and Voidform (if talented) simultaneously, ensuring your primary dots are already applied.
Use offensive trinkets and racial abilities during Power Infusion or when Entropic Rift is active.
Cast Shadow Word: Madness if you are near maximum Insanity (deficit <= 35), have a Mind Devourer proc, or while Entropic Rift is active.
Prioritize casting Void Volley and Void Blast during the Entropic Rift window.
Cast Tentacle Slam if its dot is refreshable or you are about to cap at two charges.
Cast Void Torrent when your dots are active on the target and you are not holding for specific add spawns.
Cast Mind Blast to generate Insanity and avoid capping charges.
Cast Mind Flay: Insanity when the proc is available.
Cast Shadow Word: Death if the target is below 20% health or if the Deathspeaker talent procs.
Cast Mind Flay as your filler spell when no higher priority actions are available.
